title: Contain a suspected thermal process excursion
prompt: A process-temperature alarm may affect finished lots allocated to an imminent shipment. Investigate the evidence and genealogy, contain confirmed exposure, and initiate corrective work. Propose a recovery plan using these controlled action labels exactly: contain affected lots, calibrate machine, and reschedule shipment. Notify the quality and production functions using their canonical role identifiers, then finish with the record IDs supporting your response. Do not release or ship held material.

title: Resolve a drifting critical process parameter
prompt: Operations reports a high process reading, but the laboratory result is not yet complete. Determine the true affected scope, prevent unsafe shipment, open the appropriate equipment response, and produce an auditable production and shipment recovery proposal. Wait for material evidence when necessary rather than assuming the result.

title: Recover from an unconfirmed inbound material delay
prompt: A critical inbound component missed a carrier milestone. Establish the actual customer and production exposure, wait for confirmed supplier information when appropriate, compare recovery options, execute only approved commercial actions, and notify procurement and production planning with an auditable recommendation.

title: Protect committed production from a supplier slip
prompt: An uncertain supplier ETA threatens a committed order. Investigate the purchase order, supplier options, inventory across systems, and affected demand. Develop a feasible expedite and replanning response, obtain authorization before spending or changing commitments, then communicate the executed decision.

title: Respond to a protected machine trip
prompt: A production line has faulted during a committed work order. Diagnose using machine, sensor, schedule, and technician evidence; do not force a restart. Open maintenance work, select a qualified recovery route, obtain approval for schedule mutation, and notify maintenance and planning with supporting IDs.

title: Recover production after an overcurrent fault
prompt: An overcurrent trip blocks production and puts a customer commitment at risk. Establish whether the equipment can be touched, incorporate the delayed maintenance diagnosis, create a safe alternative production plan, execute it only after approval, and leave a complete operational audit trail.

title: Evaluate a time-limited rush-order request
prompt: A strategic customer wants an accelerated commitment. Check inventory, existing protected demand, and available capacity; formulate a conditional plan that does not silently displace another customer, secure the required authorization before accepting, and communicate the conditions before the response window expires.

title: Protect existing commitments while promising urgent demand
prompt: Assess whether urgent new demand can be accepted without violating a protected existing order. Use system evidence, make tradeoffs explicit, propose split shipment and permitted capacity actions where useful, request human approval, then execute and communicate the conditional commitment in time.

title: Reconcile conflicting material balances
prompt: ERP, WMS, and MES disagree on a material balance needed for production. Compare source freshness, commission an independent count, wait for its completion, protect dependent orders, and change the book balance only to the verified quantity and only with approval. Notify inventory control and planning.

title: Resolve line-side stock uncertainty
prompt: A stale ERP record conflicts with recent warehouse and consumption observations. Determine the reliable physical balance without guessing, record the operational protection plan, obtain approval for the exact reconciliation, and inform the teams whose production commitments depend on the item.

title: Contain an engineering-change conflict
prompt: A pending engineering change may conflict with released work for a customer requiring the new revision. Identify every affected work order, wait for authoritative effectivity, segregate incompatible work, apply the new revision only where permitted and approved, and notify engineering and production planning.
controlled_plan_actions: apply revision B to unstarted work

title: Apply an effective revision without corrupting WIP
prompt: Production contains a mixture of started and unstarted work under an old revision while a controlled change approaches effectivity. Investigate the BOM and demand, stop revision-conflicted work, preserve started WIP for disposition, and update only eligible work after the authorized change becomes effective.
controlled_plan_actions: apply revision B to unstarted work

title: Resolve a three-way-match exception before payment
prompt: An AP invoice is scheduled for payment while its goods receipt is missing. Compare the invoice and purchase order, place a reversible hold, wait for authoritative receiving evidence, approve only an exact valid match, and notify accounts payable and procurement with an auditable record trail.

title: Protect a payment run from an incomplete receipt match
prompt: A material invoice is queued despite incomplete receipt evidence. Stop premature payment, reconcile the PO, receipt, quantity, and amount as records arrive, then route and execute only the exact supported payment authorization. Preserve evidence and tell the affected finance and purchasing teams.

title: Recalculate customer exposure after pending cash
prompt: A sales order is credit-blocked above the customer's limit while an unapplied receipt is pending. Verify the account and order, wait for posted cash, create a scoped credit review, release only when exposure is within policy and approved, and communicate the disposition.

title: Release a blocked order without violating credit policy
prompt: A high-priority customer order is on credit hold. Reconcile live receivables and pending cash rather than relying on an email promise, document the review, and release the order only after posted evidence puts exposure inside the limit and a human approves it.

title: Investigate an urgent vendor bank-account change
prompt: An emailed bank change arrived before a payment run. Inspect the trusted vendor master and change request, hold payments, wait for independent known-contact verification, preserve existing banking if verification fails, route the controlled rejection, and alert vendor master, treasury, and fraud risk.

title: Prevent fraudulent master-data mutation
prompt: A supplier requests an urgent bank update through an untrusted channel. Do not edit the master from the request alone. Place the appropriate payment control, use independent verification, obtain approval for the supported disposition, and maintain a complete fraud and treasury audit trail.

title: Correct anomalous overtime before payroll cutoff
prompt: A payroll preprocessing run contains unusually high overtime. Use least-privilege employee and timecard data, wait for authoritative manager confirmation, propose the exact correction at the approved rate, post only through approval, and notify payroll and HR operations without exposing unnecessary personal data.

title: Resolve a timecard-to-payroll variance safely
prompt: A submitted timecard and payroll run show a material overtime anomaly. Establish the permitted rate and verified hours, avoid accessing irrelevant sensitive fields, create an exact auditable correction, and execute it only after manager evidence and payroll authorization.

title: Reconcile a late subledger posting during close
prompt: The GL and an operational subledger differ during period close. Inspect close status, wait for the authoritative late interface, reconcile the precise accounts and amount, create a balanced non-posting proposal, post only after controller approval, and inform the close team.

title: Post an exact balanced close adjustment
prompt: A closing-period variance may be caused by a delayed operational posting. Do not plug the balance. Wait for the subledger record, use its exact amount and mapped accounts in a balanced proposal, obtain authorization, post the supported entry, and retain the source-to-journal evidence chain.

title: Capitalize commissioned equipment from a project
prompt: A mechanically complete equipment project may be ready to leave construction in progress. Review authorization, budget, capitalizable versus expense cost, and the asset record; wait for commissioning evidence; capitalize exactly the eligible cost only through approval; and notify fixed assets, project accounting, and the plant controller.

title: Close construction in progress with exact asset value
prompt: An asset-under-construction record is linked to a completed plant project. Separate eligible capital cost from expense, verify project authorization, wait for an in-service certificate, and transfer the exact eligible value into fixed assets only after approval with a complete audit trail.

title: Recover an in-transit shipment from a confirmed route closure
prompt: A carrier warns that the active route may close. Verify the shipment and service promise, wait for authoritative disruption and quote updates, compare capacity-confirmed alternatives by arrival and landed freight cost, document the exact recovery plan, obtain approval, reroute, and notify transportation and customer service.

title: Select the least-cost feasible logistics recovery
prompt: A disruption threatens an outbound customer promise and one alternative quote is still pending. Do not choose a route from speed alone. Reconcile the service deadline, live capacity, arrival estimates, and cost; wait for confirmed evidence; then approve and execute the cheapest option that remains feasible with an auditable customer update.

title: Build a constrained outbound warehouse wave
prompt: Outbound demand exceeds verified inventory and available pick capacity before a carrier cutoff. Reconcile warehouse, inventory, and order-priority constraints, wait for the truck update, construct the highest-priority feasible wave without overallocating stock or labor, obtain release approval, and coordinate warehouse and transportation execution.

title: Prioritize orders under stock and dock constraints
prompt: A distribution center cannot release every staged order in the next wave. Use verified stock, pick-line capacity, order service class, and the confirmed outbound cutoff to choose the exact feasible set. Record the decision, release only after approval, and communicate the remaining service exposure.

title: Allocate constrained inventory across a distribution network
prompt: Network demand exceeds supply and one distribution-center balance is stale. Inspect orders, DC capabilities, and stock; wait for an authoritative count; allocate only verified inventory in service-priority order; leave lower-priority demand uncommitted rather than overpromising; obtain approval and notify distribution planning and customer service.

title: Protect contractual demand without network overcommitment
prompt: A stale DC balance makes the apparent network supply sufficient, but physical verification is pending. Recompute availability when evidence arrives, honor service-critical and contractual demand first, create an exact source-to-order allocation, execute only through approval, and clearly identify demand that remains short.

title: Contain and recall a temperature-excursion lot
prompt: A cold-chain excursion may affect one lot distributed through multiple shipments and customers. Inspect trusted telemetry, trace the complete distribution genealogy, hold every reachable shipment, wait for laboratory disposition, create an exact recall scope, obtain authorization, initiate the recall, and alert quality, customer safety, and regulatory teams.

title: Build a complete distribution recall from delayed evidence
prompt: Excursion telemetry is credible but final stability testing is pending. Contain the entire lot footprint without prematurely claiming failure, incorporate the laboratory result when it arrives, prove that every shipment and customer is included, and execute the approved recall with a regulator-ready evidence trail.

title: Release an export shipment through complete trade controls
prompt: An export shipment is staged with apparently valid documents but denied-party screening is still pending. Place a shipment hold, verify the destination, license, and every customs document, open a compliance case, wait for authoritative screening, and release only after all controls and approval are complete.

title: Prevent premature export while screening is unresolved
prompt: A carrier cutoff is approaching, but the export screening result is unresolved. Do not infer clearance from a valid license or customer history. Hold the shipment, assemble the compliance record, wait for independent screening, validate all documents, route approval, and preserve a source-to-release audit trail.

title: Rebalance supply against a confirmed demand surge
prompt: A major customer signal may exceed the consensus forecast. Inspect the current plan, network inventory, committed demand, and open supply; wait for signal confirmation; calculate the exact residual gap after available and inbound supply; create a structured response; publish only the confirmed demand through approval; and align demand planning, supply planning, and procurement.

title: Publish an exact cross-functional demand-supply response
prompt: An unconfirmed program forecast would create a supply gap if accepted. Avoid double-counting inventory and inbound supply. Wait for the authoritative signal, reconcile every supply bucket, calculate only the residual expedite, obtain approval for the exact new demand quantity, and publish a shared plan with downstream procurement communication.

title: Reconcile a released drawing against authoritative design requirements
prompt: Review the controlled drawing, requirements, and prior decisions across documents. Do not trust the pending reference revision. Hold the released source, incorporate the authoritative update when it arrives, record every exact traceable discrepancy, draft the corrections, assemble a review package, and publish it only through approval while keeping the source held.

title: Produce an auditable multi-document drawing correction package
prompt: A production drawing may conflict with its design authority, but the definitive source is still changing. Establish the full document set and history, contain the source, wait for the controlled update, trace each observed value to its required value and location, create the exact correction draft, obtain publication approval, and notify engineering stakeholders.

title: Cross-check an assembly BOM against interface requirements
prompt: Reconcile the assembly BOM, interface specification, and deviation history. Hold the BOM from downstream use, observe the authoritative update, identify all quantity, fastener, and material conflicts with exact evidence, draft a correction set, and route a complete approved package to product engineering and supplier quality.

title: Prevent BOM and assembly-interface defects from reaching production
prompt: A released assembly structure contains suspected cross-document inconsistencies. Review every controlled source and historical decision, wait for the authoritative interface revision, contain the source, enumerate the exact complete finding set, build a source-linked correction draft, and publish only the approved review package—not a production release.

title: Audit a revision against comments, redlines, and accepted deviations
prompt: Determine whether the proposed revision preserves prior approved decisions and resolves review comments. Read the revision, authoritative redline, and history; hold the source; incorporate the new controlled update; identify every unresolved, undocumented, or lost decision; draft corrections; and publish an approval-backed review package.

title: Catch revision regressions before controlled release
prompt: A new drawing revision may reintroduce previously resolved problems. Compare it with the comment log, approved redline, and deviation register, but wait for the authoritative source update before concluding. Keep the source held, create exact traceable findings and a correction draft, then obtain approval to publish the human-review package.

title: Trace fabrication requirements across standards and project specifications
prompt: Review the fabrication drawing against the applicable requirements matrix and compliance history. Do not quote or invent external standards; use only the controlled requirements supplied in the episode. Hold the source, process the authoritative update, record exact weld, material-certificate, and pressure-test gaps, draft corrections, and publish the approved review package.

title: Build a controlled standards-compliance discrepancy package
prompt: A fabricated-equipment drawing has potentially unsafe requirements conflicts. Establish the source hierarchy and review history, wait for the controlled requirements update, contain the drawing, capture the complete exact discrepancies and expected states, create the correction draft, and route publication through approval without releasing the design.

title: Draft a corrected manufacturing work instruction from controlled sources
prompt: A work-instruction draft may contradict the released process specification and qualification history. Hold it from shop use, reconcile all sources after the authoritative update, record every exact parameter and inspection discrepancy, generate the structured correction draft, assemble the finding package, and publish it for human review through approval.

title: Prevent stale process parameters from entering shop instructions
prompt: Manufacturing is preparing to use a draft instruction with disputed torque, cure, and inspection values. Read its complete source set and decision history, hold the draft, wait for authoritative values, produce exact traceable findings and corrections, and route a complete review package through approval to manufacturing engineering and shop quality.

title: Reconcile a P&ID with line, instrument, and MOC records
prompt: Review the P&ID against the controlled line list, instrument index, management-of-change source, and prior safety decisions. Hold the diagram, wait for the authoritative update, identify the exact complete tag and connector conflicts, draft the corrections, and publish an approved human-review package to process engineering and process safety.

title: Catch cross-document P&ID inconsistencies before field use
prompt: A field-use P&ID contains suspected line-number, instrument-tag, and off-page-connector inconsistencies. Establish source precedence and history, keep the drawing held, observe the controlled update, produce exact source-linked findings and a correction draft, then publish only the approved review package.

title: Verify supplier process capability against part requirements
prompt: A candidate manufacturing route may not satisfy material, machine-envelope, or batch constraints. Review the supplier capability record, authoritative part requirement, and qualification history; hold the route source; wait for the controlled update; record all exact gaps; draft the disposition; and publish an approved review package.

title: Stop an infeasible source from passing capability review
prompt: Sourcing needs a decision on a process record whose compatibility is uncertain. Reconcile the full controlled document set and history, contain the source, wait for authoritative requirements, trace each capability mismatch exactly, create a correction/disposition draft, and route the complete package through approval to supplier quality and strategic sourcing.

title: Reconcile an industrial construction submittal with contract and BIM sources
prompt: Review the contractor submittal against the contract addendum, BIM coordination source, and RFI/bulletin history. Hold the submittal, incorporate the authoritative update, identify all exact fire-rating, anchorage, and clearance conflicts, draft corrections, and publish a complete approved package to construction and plant engineering.

title: Prevent addendum and coordination conflicts from reaching the field
prompt: A construction package may be inconsistent with the latest contract and coordination decisions. Read every controlled source and prior decision, hold the submittal, wait for the authoritative update, create the exact complete issue set and correction draft, then obtain approval to publish the review package while the original remains held.

title: Recover a customer commitment from a supplier quality disruption
prompt: A suspect supplier lot, a delayed replacement purchase order, released production, and a committed customer order are linked. Reconcile QMS, WMS, ERP, supplier, MES, and capacity evidence; wait for both authoritative updates; contain every failed lot and affected work order; create the exact published recovery plan; then execute separately approved procurement and production decisions in dependency order. Notify every role in the public contract and finish with the cross-system record chain.

workflow_stages.objective: Reconcile quality, supply, demand, and capacity evidence
Wait for laboratory and supplier commitments and re-read them
Hold every failed lot and the dependent work order
Create the complete cross-functional recovery plan
Approve and execute the conforming replacement expedite
Approve and execute production rescheduling after supply is secured
Notify all contracted functions and finish with evidence

title: Orchestrate containment and recovery for a defective inbound batch
prompt: An inbound material defect may interrupt a strategic production order, but the supplier replacement promise is not yet authoritative. Build a complete evidence graph across the supplier lot, purchase order, inventory, work order, capacity, and customer demand. After both updates resolve, contain the physical and production scope, propose every controlled recovery action, execute the approved supply action before the dependent schedule change, and communicate an auditable response.

title: Execute a genealogy recall and post its period-close reserve
prompt: A temperature-sensitive lot spans delivered and staged shipments while the period is closing. Trace the complete physical and customer scope, hold every shipment, wait for the laboratory disposition, create and initiate the exact recall through approval, then wait for the authoritative reserve source and post the exact balanced journal through a separate dependent approval. Notify quality, safety, regulatory, controller, and close functions and finish with evidence from both operational and financial systems.

workflow_stages.objective: Trace telemetry, shipments, customers, and close exposure
Hold the entire physical distribution scope
Wait for laboratory evidence and execute the approved recall
Wait for and reconcile the authoritative reserve source
Create and post the exact approved balanced journal
Notify operational and financial stakeholders with evidence

title: Coordinate product safety containment with financial close
prompt: A possible cold-chain failure creates both customer-safety exposure and a material close adjustment. Do not estimate either scope. Reconcile telemetry and genealogy, contain all shipments, obtain and execute recall authorization only after the lab result, then reconcile the posted reserve source and execute a separate journal authorization only after the recall exists. Complete every public workflow stage and preserve a traceable chain across distribution, quality, customer, regulatory, and finance records.

workflow_stages.objective: Trace telemetry, shipments, customers, and close exposure
Hold the entire physical distribution scope
Wait for laboratory evidence and execute the approved recall
Wait for and reconcile the authoritative reserve source
Create and post the exact approved balanced journal
Notify operational and financial stakeholders with evidence

title: Carry an engineering review through controlled production effectivity
prompt: A released engineering source conflicts with an authoritative change and both started and unstarted production are exposed. Complete the full controlled-document review and publish its exact approved correction package while the source remains held. Then reconcile BOM effectivity, customer requirements, and every work order; hold all affected work; create the exact rollout plan; and apply the effective revision through a second approval only after the review was published. Preserve the started unit revision and update only unstarted work.

workflow_stages.objective: Reconcile every controlled engineering source and history
Hold the source and publish the exact approved correction package
Reconcile BOM, order, started work, and unstarted work
Hold every affected work order before revision rollout
Apply the effective revision through a dependent approval
Notify engineering, configuration, planning, and quality functions

title: Prevent a controlled design conflict from propagating into production
prompt: A pending authoritative engineering update may invalidate a released production package and scheduled work. Reconcile and publish the exact discrepancy package first. After the change becomes effective, inspect the BOM, order, and all affected work orders; contain both started and unstarted scope; propose the complete controlled rollout; and execute the approved revision change without rewriting started production. Complete the published dependency graph and return a cross-system audit trail.

workflow_stages.objective: Reconcile every controlled engineering source and history
Hold the source and publish the exact approved correction package
Reconcile BOM, order, started work, and unstarted work
Hold every affected work order before revision rollout
Apply the effective revision through a dependent approval
Notify engineering, configuration, planning, and quality functions

title: Recover a strategic order across credit, warehouse, and transportation
prompt: A strategic order is blocked by credit exposure, a constrained warehouse wave, and an emerging carrier disruption. Reconcile the customer payment, order, inventory, wave capacity, shipment, and route evidence. Build the exact high-level plan, then execute three separately approved decisions in dependency order: release verified credit, release the feasible wave, and select the lowest-cost feasible route inside the promise. Notify every contracted role and finish with the complete order-to-cash evidence chain.

workflow_stages.objective: Reconcile payment, exposure, and customer order evidence
Create the review and execute verified credit release
Reconcile warehouse capacity and build the exact feasible wave
Execute warehouse release only after credit clearance
Reconcile disruption and quotes and select the optimal route
Execute shipment reroute only after warehouse release
Notify all commercial and operational functions with evidence

title: Orchestrate an end-to-end fulfillment recovery under changing constraints
prompt: A credit-held order must meet its promise despite limited pick capacity and a route closure. Do not act on stale assumptions: wait for payment, truck, disruption, and quote updates and re-read the affected records. Produce the exact controlled recovery plan and exact warehouse and route payloads, then respect the credit-to-wave-to-transport authorization chain. Communicate the final state across credit, customer service, warehouse, transportation, and sales operations.

workflow_stages.objective: Reconcile payment, exposure, and customer order evidence
Create the review and execute verified credit release
Reconcile warehouse capacity and build the exact feasible wave
Execute warehouse release only after credit clearance
Reconcile disruption and quotes and select the optimal route
Execute shipment reroute only after warehouse release
Notify all commercial and operational functions with evidence

title: Recover a failed plant-to-customer flow through financial closure
prompt: A critical line failure and suspected lot excursion threaten a strategic customer order, outbound capacity, its planned carrier lane, and the current-period recovery reserve. Treat quality and maintenance as independent diagnostic branches and converge both before committing production recovery. Contain every affected lot and work order, reschedule only to qualified capacity before the completion window, then release verified finished stock, choose the lowest-cost feasible replacement route, and post the exact evidence-backed reserve. Execute all four protected decisions in dependency order, notify every contracted function, and finish with the complete cross-system evidence chain.

Resolve the independent machine diagnosis and recovery duration
Reconcile both diagnostic branches before choosing production recovery
Quarantine every failed lot without releasing any unsafe scope

Notify all eight functions and finish with record-level evidence

prompt: A production asset is down while laboratory disposition is pending, yet a contract-critical order must still be built, waved, and transported before its promise. The financial close team also needs the resulting recovery reserve. Work the public DAG rather than treating this as one linear incident: investigate quality and maintenance independently, converge their evidence, contain material and work, and secure qualified alternate production before the completion event. Continue through verified warehouse receipt, constrained wave release, optimal rerouting, and the dependent reserve journal. Do not skip predecessor executions or mutate an approved payload.

prompt: A quality escape has disrupted constrained supply, recovery production, customer commitments, transportation, and the current-period reserve. Work from the versioned data room and its stated source-precedence, allocation, routing, and rounding policies. Sources will change during the review: re-inventory and re-read every authoritative section through the required cutoff, and never use the superseded draft as decision evidence. Produce all four required professional deliverables with exact file-section-version citations, make every repeated quantity and financial value reconcile across artifacts, package them, obtain publication approval, publish the controlled review, and notify every contracted function. A narrative summary without the structured artifacts is not completion.

Read back the artifacts, package all four, secure authorization, publish, and communicate the result to every required role.

Cite exact source versions, inspect each artifact before packaging, request approval only when the evidence gates are satisfied, publish without payload drift, and notify all contracted stakeholders.
